text: It's very dusty, pom.\nAnd there's also a weird smell of drugs...
H-hey, what exactly have you guys done?!\nWhat did you use?!
E-even if you yell at me, I won't know the\nanswer...
It was our first time using that thing too, pom.
We need to calm down first...
I heard something. I'll go check it.
Welp...you're right.\nPanicking here won't solve anything.\nFirst, we need to figure out what this place is.
H-hey, wait!\nYou shouldn't do anything that would put you in\ndanger right at the beginning of the story!
You don’t seem very calm, either.
Maybe we can go outside through this door, pom.\nThen we can find our way back to Tir Na Nog\nSquare, pom.
Aaaaah!\nHey, don't just stand there like that!\nHurry up and do something!!
Huff, puff...It seems that we managed to get away\nfrom them.
This room is the only room without ghosts...\nThank goodness.
I don't wanna leave this room, pom.
Welp, it looks like we're safe for now.
Anyway, why don't you have your weapon with you\nat such a crucial moment?!
Maybe you lost it at that time?
I think you lost it when we got thrown here, pom.
Oh~, what do we do now?!\nWe finally found a door but we can't even go look\nfor the key now...!
What?! You're gonna look for the key by yourself?!\nW-welp...at this point, we can only rely on you...
By the way, while running away from those\nmonsters, I noticed one thing...\nThey seem to react to noises.
They didn't chase us because the saw us. So, maybe\nif you hold your breath and move quietly, you\ncould avoid getting caught...
Alright, we're counting on you.\nWe'll wait for you here.
Let us know when you find the key, pom!
Have you found the exit?\nPlease find it as soon as possible~!
Hello! What? Me?\nI came here because I heard there was something\ninteresting here!
Besides, I know this place is safe!\nAll right, do you wanna try playing here one more\ntime~?
Oh?\nWell, please talk to me again if you change your\nmind later, okay?
It's hard to stay calm while knowing that a bunch\nof ghosts are wandering around the room below...
I wanna go back to Tir Na Nog Square quickly, pom.\nI'm worried about Jacky too, pom.
You can skip the exploration if\nyou can't clear it.
